scripts.build: npm run build -w @soundspace/shared && npm run build -w @soundspace/api && npm run build -w @soundspace/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @soundspace/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @soundspace/api" "npm run dev -w @soundspace/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @soundspace/shared && npm run typecheck -w @soundspace/api && npm run typecheck -w @soundspace/web && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
